issues.text: Cancelling the four handoffs (DOC-10, DOC-11) alone turns `handoffs-check` and `npm run check` red: tools/handoffs/exceptions.tsv holds four rows for them (lines 21, 117, 118, 119), and an unused row is a violation; test HC-7c in tools/test/handoffs-real.test.js also fixes 114 rows and the step-10 row. Plan task M0.10 gives the cancellations to ORCH as a separate action. REQ-103 (criteria 7 and 8, table rows 1-2) therefore ties the cancellation, the deletion of the four rows and the HC-7c edit into one change; ORCH must not cancel them as a stand-alone step. The rows are exceptions made once on the base commit; deleting a row that has no violation any more does not weaken the check (the sketch is in self_check). Whoever edits tools/ in the run M0DOCS is named by the FULL run (TEST-DESIGNER/CODE-FIXER by the table).

The task says REQ-001 and REQ-007 need 'one consented real session and the owner's confirmation of the look'. In the blocks, the look (criterion 16) belongs to REQ-007 only; REQ-001 has only the real-session items (criterion 1, UAT items of 3 (д), 9, 10 (в), (ж)). I wrote that: REQ-001's reason is the real session; REQ-007's reason is the real session and the look. The old remark in REQ-001 that REQ-002 is not done is out of date (REQ-002 done since 2026-10-11); I only said so in the new comment and did not change the old text.

Choices made inside REQ-103 that the plan did not fix (the gate may change them, they are not decisions of record): 'one screen' = the first `---` line not below line 50; the labels of the top block of STATE.md are English («State», «Open gates», «Next step») because decision 0080 puts instructions in English, while the three copied sections stay Russian; docs/product first line has the form «Snapshot of YYYY-MM-DD; current: docs/program/public-v1/»; ideas/README.md line 9 must lose «Выбрана» and cite decisions/0033 (the idea 02-sai is the dropped clothing-shop hypothesis); README counts and open defects are compared with the base tag of the run M0DOCS (not with live files), so they cannot go stale by the status change of REQ-103 itself. If ORCH wants any of these otherwise, tell me before the gate.

Order of runs: criteria 1-2 and 5 compare with the base tag M0DOCS-<date>-01, which ORCH sets before the first edit of the run: it must be set after the commit of this run (M0BACKLOG) so that the tag holds the new statuses and the old STATE.md/PLAN.md.
